summary:
The Haves And The Have Nots
During their meeting on 27 November 2014, the members of the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries ("OPEC") decided not to cut production to arrest a slide in global oil prices. The next day Brent oil fell more than $6 to $71.25, a price decline described at the time as "sending benchmark crude plunging to a fresh four-year low". Ah, the good ol' days ...
